name: Bride-to-Be Kayleigh

intro.text: I'm getting married on Saturday and this is my last night of freedom! Well, my fourth last night. Sash on, L-plates on, let's battle!

win: Oh, I don't care, I'm getting MARRIED!
after: The girls have gone to see the drag show at the Winter Gardens. I said I'd catch up. In a minute. After a sit down.
